title: Refactor xtask into modules

in: Split xtask implementation into modules with clap CLI structs/enums centralized and each cbd subcommand handler in its own file.
Move shared helpers into util modules as applicable (paths, fs, json, template, prompt, process, git).
Keep the public CLI and behavior unchanged (command names, arguments, exit codes, verification logic).
Keep output formats, templates, and generated file contents unchanged.
out: Add new CLI flags or subcommands.
Change exit codes, error handling semantics, or verification logic.
Change JSON schema or template formats or generated outputs.

postconditions.statement: If the contract file exists, parses as JSON, has status "ready", and has no open_questions, the command exits with code 0 and prints "Contract <id> is ready.".

errors.when: The contract file .cbd/contracts/<id>.contract.json does not exist.
The contract file exists but is invalid JSON.
errors.response: Exit code 3 and prints "Invalid JSON in <path>: ...".

errors.when: The contract status is not "ready" or open_questions is non-empty.
errors.response: Exit code 4 and prints status/open_questions details.

postconditions.statement: If all gates pass (ready/implemented contract, bundle coverage, evidence coverage, and checks), the command exits with code 0 and prints "cbd verify <id>: OK".

errors.when: The contract, bundle, or evidence file is missing.
Contract/bundle/evidence JSON is invalid or fails structural validation (invalid clause ids, invalid acceptance_tests.proves, unknown clause ids in bundle or evidence).
errors.response: Exit code 3 and prints the validation error.

errors.when: Contract status is not "ready" or "implemented", or open_questions is non-empty.
errors.response: Exit code 4 and prints the not-ready details.

errors.when: Bundle planning coverage is missing or evidence lacks required clause proofs.
errors.response: Exit code 4 and prints missing clause ids.

errors.when: Cargo or TypeScript checks invoked by verify fail.
errors.response: Exit code 1 and prints the failing command and exit code.

system_invariants.statement: CLI definitions include only the following cbd subcommands and flags (no additions/removals): new-task (--id, --slug, --force default false, --interactive default false), new-epic (--id, --slug, --force default false, --interactive default false), new-review (--id, --slug, --title optional, --force default false, --interactive default false), validate-ready (--id), verify (--id).
Help output renders successfully (exit code 0) for `xtask --help`, `xtask cbd --help`, and each cbd subcommand `--help`.
xtask/src/main.rs only parses CLI args, calls cbd::run, and exits with the returned code; cbd command logic is not implemented in main.rs.
Clap derive types (Cli, CbdCommand, NewTaskArgs, NewEpicArgs, NewReviewArgs, ValidateReadyArgs, VerifyArgs) live in xtask/src/cli.rs.
cbd dispatch lives in xtask/src/cbd/mod.rs and each cbd subcommand handler is implemented in its own module file: new_task.rs, new_epic.rs, new_review.rs, validate_ready.rs, verify.rs.
Shared helpers are organized under xtask/src/util/{paths,fs,json,template,prompt,process}.rs and used by cbd handlers; helper logic is no longer in main.rs.
No new dependencies are added to xtask/Cargo.toml.

acceptance_tests.description: Help output exits 0 for: `cargo run --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml -- --help`, `cargo run --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml -- cbd --help`, and each cbd subcommand help (`new-task`, `new-epic`, `new-review`, `validate-ready`, `verify`).
Exercise `cbd validate-ready` with: missing contract (exit 2), invalid JSON (exit 3), not ready/open_questions (exit 4), ready (exit 0).
Exercise `cbd verify` with: missing artifacts (exit 2), invalid JSON/schema (exit 3), not ready/open_questions (exit 4), missing planning or proofs (exit 4), and a successful run (exit 0).

definition_of_done: each clause id in pre/post/invariants/errors has a proof entry in evidence.json
Rust enforcement is authoritative; TypeScript enforcement is UX-only
